newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Roche buys Europe vitamin, tonic business.
newsitem.headline: Roche buys Europe vitamin, tonic business.

text.p: BASLE, Switzerland, Dec 23 - Roche Holding AG said it had agreed to buy the European vitamin and tonic brands of Rhone-Poulenc Rorer, acquiring a business with 1996 sales of about $60 million.
Roche said the transaction included product rights and inventories in Germany, Switzerland and Poland, mainly in tonics, vitamins anmd garlic supplements.
Roche said the lead brands in the agreement were the Biovital line of tonics and vitamins and garlic supplement Ilja Rogoff.

"The acquisition strengthens Roche Consumer Health's leading position in the European vitamin and mineral supplement market, in particular through a significant increase in critical mass in this segment in the important German market," Roche said.
Roche said the deal would also provide potential for growth into Eastern European markets for self-medication products
